title: Comparative Evaluation of Different Sludge Thickening Processes
markdown:
| Evaluation Criteria | Gravity | Dissolved Air Flotation | Centrifugation | Gravity Belt | Rotating Drum |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Space requirement | High | Medium | Low | Medium | Medium |
| Operation and maintenance | Simple | Medium | High | Medium | Medium |
| Typical Application | Primary and Combined | Waste activated sludge | Waste activated sludge | Waste activated sludge | Waste activated sludge |
| Conditioning Chemicals | None | High | High | Medium | Medium |
| Power requirement | Low | High | High | Medium | Medium |
| Capital Cost | Low | High | High | Medium | Medium |
| Operation Cost | Low | High | High | Medium | Medium |
| Thickened Sludge solids concentration | Medium | Low | High | Medium to high | Medium to high |
| Building corrosion if enclosed | High | Medium | None | Medium | Medium |
| Odour problem | Serious | Moderate | Low | Moderate | Moderate |
notes: Header 'Dissolved Air Flotation' is printed on two lines; the two-line break is not collapsible in a table cell and is joined with a single space.

Row labels are printed with capitalised second words ('Typical Application', 'Conditioning Chemicals', 'Capital Cost', 'Operation Cost') on some rows and lower case on others ('Space requirement', 'Power requirement'); case kept as printed.
British spelling 'Odour problem' kept; not changed to 'Odor'.
No source line or footnote is printed with this table.

transcription.method: Direct visual reading of full 144 dpi annotation-cleaned page PNGs plus 288-450 dpi detail crops of each item, rotated where the printed table is set sideways; no OCR, no paid service, no delegation
transcription.observations: First reading only. Every printed value, coefficient, power, sign, bracket, spelling and unit retained as printed; source oddities kept and flagged rather than corrected. No distinct second visual pass performed and no verification seal.

visual_recheck.method: Distinct parent comparison of each selected production source-region crop and 216-dpi zoom; no whole-page review; not independent human review.
visual_recheck.observations: Compared every selected header, cell and in-crop footnote. All printed table values match the saved first-reading drafts. Removed out-of-crop context and unnecessary draft commentary; multiline header is not a cell merge.
